programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.sub_title: Daniel's Important Job At The Market
programs.desc: Daniel and Dad help Prince Tuesday on a busy day at the Market. Daniel can't help with the cash register, but learns that there are lots of other jobs - and each one is important.

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: While her robot assistant works on the chores, Nim makes a rocket, bakes a ladybird biscuit and draws something inspired by a loud sound in the empty room.

programs.title: Play School
programs.desc: Miah and Michelle explore all things big and small in the sea! Michelle makes a small sailboat, and races Miah's big tugboat. In the big Play School pop-up book a little boat sails in the big blue sea.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Tsehay and Henry the Octopus are in the Wiggly Kitchen, there are so many amazing musical sounds and it's great for salsa practice. Tsehay and Henry find a blue teddy bear painting, who could it belong to?

programs.title: Thomas & Friends
programs.desc: Yong Bao tells Thomas the story of how he came to have a magnificent tiger emblem on his tender.

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Miffy and her dad are planning a secret campsite in the garden. No one knows... but Miffy is so excited to go on this Father-Daughter camping trip that she ends up talking about it and inviting everyone.

programs.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programs.desc: Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes help a lost Baby Cuke back to its herd, but the teething Cuke's incessant need to suck makes the process more difficult than expected.

programs.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programs.desc: Andy heads 49 million years back in time to find out the colour of a prehistoric bird's eggs. But when he finally tracks down a nest, a new chick starts to hatch and he must protect it against a colony of prehistoric ants.

programs.title: Santiago of the Seas
programs.desc: It's a nighttime chase above and below the sea when Escarlata turns the moon into a fish.

programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: A mystery is afoot! Somebody’s been digging up and running off with Jackson’s giant vegetables. Detectives Mojo and Bo must follow the clues to the cagey culprit.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: Lucky’s Dad, Lucky and Chucky have come over to the Heelers’ house to watch a rugby final together.
